title: How Long Do Leftovers Last in the Fridge?

seo.title: How Long Leftovers Last in the Fridge
seo.meta_description: Most cooked leftovers keep 3–4 days at 40°F/4°C or below. Learn how to cool, store, reheat and know when to discard them.
seo.search_intent: Safe refrigerator storage of leftovers in the U.S.

excerpt: USDA recommends using most cooked leftovers within 3–4 days at 40°F/4°C or below. Prompt cooling matters as much as the calendar.
content_html:
USDA recommends using most cooked leftovers within 3–4 days when they are refrigerated at 40°F / 4°C or below. The window assumes the food was cooled promptly and handled safely before refrigeration.

General guide

SituationGuidance
Most cooked leftovers3–4 days
At room temperatureRefrigerate within 2 hours
Above 90°F / 32°CRefrigerate within 1 hour
Will not be eaten in timeFreeze promptly

Cool food promptly

Large pots and deep casseroles can stay warm in the center for hours. Divide leftovers into shallow containers so they cool more quickly.

Keep the refrigerator cold

A refrigerator should stay at 40°F / 4°C or below. A simple appliance thermometer is more reliable than guessing from how cold the food feels.

Some foods need extra attention

Rice deserves particularly careful cooling because of Bacillus cereus. Seafood and delicate cream- or egg-based dishes may also lose quality quickly even within a safe refrigerator window.

Reheating

USDA recommends reheating leftovers to 165°F / 74°C. Reheat only the portion you need rather than repeatedly warming and cooling the whole container.

Reheating does not reset the clock

Lasagna cooked Monday and reheated Wednesday is still Monday's leftover. Heating it again does not create a new 3–4 day period.

Smell and appearance

Mold, off odor, gas, swollen containers or slime are reasons to discard food. A normal smell does not justify keeping leftovers beyond the recommended window.

Freezing

If you know you will not finish the food within 3–4 days, freeze it while it is still fresh. Label the date and use meal-sized portions.

Bottom line

For most U.S. leftovers: cool within 2 hours, refrigerate at 40°F/4°C or below and use within 3–4 days. Freeze early when you will not finish them in time.

Sources

Storage times and temperatures come from FoodSafety.gov and USDA FSIS.

faq.question: How long are leftovers safe in the fridge?
faq.answer: Most cooked leftovers keep 3–4 days at 40°F/4°C or below.

faq.question: Does reheating reset the 3–4 days?
faq.answer: No. The storage window is based on when the food was originally prepared.

faq.question: When should I freeze leftovers?
faq.answer: Freeze them early if you know you will not eat them within 3–4 days.
